item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 08/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense winter monsoon, the weather will be cold in the morning and at night over the coast of southern China, and very cold over inland areas today and tomorrow. It will become fine and very dry. With the monsoon being replaced by a fresh to strong easterly airstream early next week, temperatures will rise gradually over the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. The weather will be relatively humid and misty with one or two rain patches.

Date/Month: 08/02 (Saturday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cold in the morning and at night. Becoming fine and very dry during the day.
Temp range: 11 - 16 C
R.H. range: 30 - 60 per Cent
PSR: Low
